title: AliExpress — O'zbekistonga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
caption: 🛍 AliExpress: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, so'mda to'lab Xitoy marketpleysi O'zbekistonga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yetkazadi — AQShdagi kabi ombor manzili kerak emas. ✅ Qulayliklari • Uzcard va Humo bilan to'lov, summa so'mda (2023-yil dekabridan) • Xitoy — O'zbekiston to'g'ridan-to'g'ri reyslari: o'rtacha ~14 kun • Uzum Market topshirish punktlari: buyurtmada xaritadan punkt tanlanadi, SMS-kod bilan olinadi • Xaridor himoyasi: tovar kelmasa yoki tavsifga mos bo'lmasa — buyurtma sahifasidan nizo (dispute) ochiladi ⚠️ E'tibor bering • Punktga yetkazish faqat «Pickup point» belgisi bor sotuvchilarda • Tovarni tekshirmasdan «Qabul qildim» tugmasini bosmang — pul sotuvchiga o'tadi • Mashhur brend juda arzon bo'lsa — nusxa bo'lishi mumkin • Muddat va to'lov shartlari o'zgarib turadi — ilovada tekshiring 🛃 Bojxona: oylik norma pochta orqali — 100 $, kuryer orqali — 200 $ (tovar narxi bo'yicha). 📲 Buyurtmangiz normasini ilovada hisoblang ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #dokon
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#dokon".
2) Center: a smartphone showing a generic shopping app with a red-orange header (no logo), a small airplane flying along a dotted arc from a tiny pagoda-style landmark toward a small parcel locker with an indigo pin, and two plain bank cards beside the phone. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of orange (#F97316); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "AliExpress: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "So'mda to'lov · ~14 kun · topshirish punkti"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.

sources.label: spot.uz — AliExpress va Uzum topshirish punktlari, 25.04.2023

notes: Yetkazish muddati (~14 kun), Uzcard/Humo va Uzum punktlari bo'yicha manbalar 2023-yilniki — 2025–26 yangilanishi topilmadi; ilovada tekshiring. AliExpress posilkalari pochta yoki kuryer kanalida kelishi aniqlanmadi — shuning uchun ikkala norma ko'rsatildi. Nizo muddatlari ilovada.
